key_catalysts: Navi Mumbai International Airport opened for commercial flights 25 Dec 2025 (phase 1 ~20 mppa); Metro 3 underground line; Metro 8 airport link planned
risks_and_setbacks: Highest prices in the dataset (median ~Rs 13,000/sqft) so lower affordability; Metro 8 still a plan
score_basis: Big delivered airport + metro; mature market so limited new-corridor upside

key_catalysts: Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat RRTS (82 km) fully inaugurated Feb 2026; NCRTC reports for 4 more corridors incl. Ghaziabad-Noida Airport
risks_and_setbacks: New RRTS corridors are only reports, no funding committed; mature market
score_basis: Strong regional rail delivered; little new supply-side catalyst inside the city

key_catalysts: Dwarka Expressway corridor; 1,000-acre Global City project; airport metro DPR (20 km underground, ~Rs 13,500 cr) awaiting MoHUA decision
risks_and_setbacks: Prices already up ~135% since 2021 on Dwarka Expressway (Anarock, Sep 2026): overheating risk; metro not yet approved
score_basis: Good pipeline but a lot already priced in

key_catalysts: Noida International Airport (Jewar) inaugurated 28 Mar 2026, commercial operations reported from 15 Jun 2026 (12 mppa phase 1, Rs ~11,200 cr); HCL-Foxconn semiconductor OSAT at Jewar (groundbreaking Feb 2026)
risks_and_setbacks: Sources disagree on exact commercial start date; Ghaziabad-Noida Airport RRTS is only a report; airport ramp-up still early
score_basis: Largest just-delivered greenfield catalyst in the dataset plus a semiconductor anchor

risks_and_setbacks: Repeated metro deadline slips (Pink Line originally 2020); Hosur airport idea blocked by BIAL 150 km clause until 2033
score_basis: Deep job market and metro expansion, but chronic delivery delays

key_catalysts: Metro Phase II (76.4 km, ~Rs 24,269 cr) DPR submitted; RGIA-Future City metro proposed; Regional Ring Road northern segment land acquisition ~90% done
risks_and_setbacks: Metro Phase II and RRR southern segment still awaiting Centre approval as of Aug 2026; expansion described as stalled

key_catalysts: Metro Lines 1 and 2 operational; Line 3 (Hinjewadi) reported to be opening in 2026 (builder blog, verify); Purandar airport: land acquisition, operations targeted ~Mar 2029 (govt review Jan 2025)
risks_and_setbacks: Purandar timeline has slipped before and sources conflict (2027 vs 2029); Line 3 opening date not independently confirmed

key_catalysts: Chennai Metro Phase II (119 km, Rs 63,246 cr) approved by Union Cabinet Oct 2024; CMRL pursuing Poonamallee-Sunguvarchatram extension
risks_and_setbacks: New TN government announced dropping the Parandur second-airport site on 24 Aug 2026; Centre says no formal request received, in-principle approval still on record
score_basis: Metro approved and under way, but second-airport plan now uncertain

key_catalysts: Micron ATMP at Sanand inaugurated 28 Feb 2026; Kaynes OSAT at Sanand inaugurated 31 Mar 2026; CG Power OSAT under execution; Tata-PSMC fab at Dholera under construction (target 2028)
risks_and_setbacks: Dholera fab is 2028 and still under construction; my listing data has only ~2,300 usable Ahmedabad rows and almost none for Sanand/Dholera

key_catalysts: ~500 large industries and ~3,000 MSMEs; Tata Electronics, TVS, Ola, Ather; Rs 24,000 cr MoUs at Sep 2025 Hosur conclave; state plans a 2,000-acre airport
risks_and_setbacks: Airport only at site-selection stage, and a BIAL agreement bars airports within 150 km until 2033; Bommasandra-Hosur metro reported technically not feasible (Oct 2025); no listing or NHB price data
score_basis: Real industrial base but infrastructure is announced, not delivered

key_catalysts: Samruddhi Mahamarg (701 km); MIHAN (~Rs 20,000 cr investment); New Nagpur 1,710-acre financial centre announced Nov 2025; Colliers ranks Nagpur #1 among 30 emerging cities
risks_and_setbacks: Some sources are developer marketing; RBI HPI for Nagpur is volatile; rental data thin (~580 rows)

risks_and_setbacks: Centre rejected the Coimbatore metro DPR twice (latest letter dated 22 Jul 2026); no listing data
score_basis: Solid local economy and airport upgrade, but metro rejected
